scientific_integrity.computations: All 5,456 exact triple minors plus exact p=3 and p=7 incidence enumeration from the eight given seed lines; executable Python 3 certificate included.
scientific_integrity.proof_scope: All odd primes and both embeddings of the quadratic coefficient ring; geometric intersection multiplicities of the specified integral model.
scientific_integrity.reused_facts: Pokora--Roulleau supply the eight-line seed, 33-line construction, complex incidence counts, and freeness; these are not claimed as new.

scientific_limitations: No claim of positive-characteristic freeness or prime-field rationality of points.
Specialization is of one fixed normalized integral presentation; other integral presentations may have distinct special fibers.
No claim that lack of indexed overlap proves universal novelty.
title: The two exceptional odd characteristics of the octagon 33-line arrangement
